title: ONSure Human Override Disposition v1
description: docs/master/semantic-assurance/158_LEARNING_VALIDATION_P0_CONTRADICTION_POLICY_BINDINGS.md class 9 (Human Override vs Self-confirmation), bound per contracts/learning-validation-p0-contradiction-contract-bindings.candidate.v1.json LC-P0-009 (HumanOverrideTrendReport, LearningCandidateAsset). '158 SS9: override는 signal이며 truth가 아니다' -- a single override event alone can never become active_knowledge. promoted_to_active_knowledge is reachable only with a stated reason, a real evidence_ref, and a confirmer_id independently distinct from overrider_id (self-confirmation is the named negative case). This is a per-event disposition, not the aggregate trend-over-time view the LC-P0-009 contract name implies -- see the runtime evidence note for what remains open.
$comment: The confirmer_id != overrider_id check (self-confirmation prohibition) is a cross-field inequality JSON Schema without $data cannot express declaratively, honestly documented here rather than faked -- enforced by the Java runtime layer (SemanticAssuranceV2WorkflowService.learningHumanOverrideDecide), same limitation and same disclosure pattern as main-branch-protection.v1.json and decision-time-knowledge-snapshot.v1.schema.json.
